description: HackMD is a collaborative Markdown workspace and knowledge base for individuals and teams. It lets users create, organize, publish, and manage notes, folders, teams, comments, versions, and related workflow automation such as webhooks.
summary: HackMD exposes three developer integration surfaces on its own domains: a token-authenticated REST API at api.hackmd.io, an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at mcp.hackmd.io with legacy bearer-token fallback, and the hackmd-cli command-line tool using the same personal API token as the REST API.
